[TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/01/24.

[FACT] The user is looking for a mid-range wireless mouse.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant confirmed that the Logitech MX Anywhere 2S has a rechargeable battery that can last up to 70 days on a single charge.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant noted that real-world usage may vary, with an expected battery life of around 40-60 days with moderate to heavy use.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned the "Smart Sleep" feature of the MX Anywhere 2S, which helps conserve battery life.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant highlighted the quick charging feature of the MX Anywhere 2S, providing up to 3 hours of use with just a 1-minute charge.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered to provide more information about the MX Anywhere 2S's sensor accuracy or button customization options.

[FACT] The user is curious about the sensor accuracy of the Logitech MX Anywhere 2S compared to other mice in the same range.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained that the MX Anywhere 2S features a high-precision optical sensor with a resolution of up to 4,000 CPI.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant compared the MX Anywhere 2S to other mice:
- Razer Viper Mini: Up to 16,000 CPI (wired mouse)
- Microsoft Arc Mouse: Up to 3,200 CPI

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned the "Logitech Flow" feature, allowing seamless switching between three devices.
